column1: # ndr_airevents.tsv - written by the map editor (Air events).
# heading = degrees clockwise from +Z; length/width metres; edge one of auto N E S W random.
# waves = type:count:delay:load;... (b = Tu-95 bomber, load bombs; t = An-2, load paratroopers).
# interval hours 0/0 = admin panel only; scene empty = the default map.
# altitude = Tu-95 metres above the ground; speedFactor = 0 inherits host, 0.2..1.5 overrides.
# #retake = the garrison's retake raids (W Tower 4): enabled frequency strength bombers bombs
#   targets(t g f) transports paratroopers helis heliTroops escort escorts faction.
#   Optional rhythm: closeDrops secondWave secondWaveDelaySeconds(90..600) intervalMinutes(3..120)
#   randomWindowMinutes(0..60) quietMinutes(3..60); quiet starts after all raid air clears.
#   Optional approach: approachMode(vary/fixed) approachHeading(0..359.99, flight clockwise from +Z).
